text: The quiet rooms on the library's second floor have been really good for group work too.
I also recommend Tellus in the mornings. It gets busier after lunch, but before 11 it is perfect.
Thanks for the tips. Booking study rooms early has saved me during exam weeks.
The part about taking real breaks is so true. Short walks between lectures help more than I expected.
I started blocking two evenings a week for hobbies, and it made my study schedule much easier to keep.
Would be nice to have a small workshop on time management for first-year students.
Interesting topic. I would love to hear more about how AI tools are being used in actual university courses.
A follow-up session with practical examples from research projects would be useful.
I voted for hiking, but an outdoor picnic on campus would also be easy for everyone to join.
Music festival sounds fun if there is a low-cost ticket option for students.
